requirements.rule: Hourly divisor 165 = 38h/settimana × 52/12 = 164.67 ≈ 165 (CCNL Area IR 2022-2024 — stesso orario di riferimento delle altre aree ARAN dirigenza). Standard contrattuale PA.
requirements.remediation: Source the divisor of the Area IR (or the INAIL base of the dirigenti) and replace 165, or mark it not applicable so the INAIL daily base is not derived from it.
